Inside, a single page, ink smeared but legible: 'If you find this, know that someone once stood on a deck and thought of home, and hoped a stranger would understand.' No name, no date, no return address. Edmund read it a dozen times by lamplight, turning it over as if the blank side might answer his questions. He went back out to check the lamp, the sea unchanged, the message already becoming part of him.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按下了静音键。路灯把空荡的街道照得发白，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，车灯划出短暂的光痕。便利店还亮着，店员靠在柜台后面打盹，货架上的面包整整齐齐。远处传来清洁车的声音，缓慢而规律，像是城市在打扫自己的梦境。几只野猫蹲在巷口，警觉地盯着每一个经过的影子。高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有几户还亮着灯，不知是谁还没睡，还是已经醒了。空气里带着凌晨特有的凉意和安静，仿佛整座城市都在等待天亮前的最后一刻喘息。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by asking a smaller version of itself to help, like Russian nesting dolls each opening to reveal a smaller one.\n- Every recursive function needs a stopping point, called a base case, or it would keep going forever like an infinite hallway of mirrors.\n- Each step hands off a slightly smaller piece of the problem until it reaches that base case, then all the answers combine going back up, like climbing back down a ladder you climbed up."}
